SELECT m.BATCH_SEQ AS batchSeq, m.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, t1.secAcctId, t1.secAcctName, t2.ps AS ps, t3.termType AS termType, m.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, m.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, m.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, m.EFF_DATE as effDate, m.CHARGE_BASIS as chargeBasis, m.FEE_MAXI as feeMaxi, m.FEE_MINI as feeMini, case when m.CHARGE_TYPE='01' then m.CHARGE_RATE * 1000 else m.CHARGE_VALUE end as chargeValue, m.CHARGE_RATE as chargeRate, m.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE as isPayWithTrade,m.WINDTYPEONE windtypeone,m.WINDTYPETWO windtypetwo,m.IS_GRADE isGrade FROM ( select distinct BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else T1.CHARGE_VALUE end as CHARGE_VALUE, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else T1.FEE_MAXI end as FEE_MAXI, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else t1.FEE_MINI end as FEE_MINI, case when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else t1.CHARGE_RATE end as CHARGE_RATE, t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,t.WINDTYPEONE,t.WINDTYPETWO,t.IS_GRADE from TRD_FEE_CONFIG t inner join TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL t1 on t.SEQ_NO=t1.CONFIG_SEQ_NO where t.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY t.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS,T1.FEE_MAXI,t1.FEE_MINI,T1.CHARGE_VALUE,t1.CHARGE_RATE,t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,t.WINDTYPEONE,t.WINDTYPETWO,t.IS_GRADE ) m INNER JOIN ( select n.BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( n.sec_acct_id, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (n.sec_acct_id)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') secAcctId , wm_concat(DISTINCT n1.sec_acct_name)as secAcctName from TRD_FEE_CONFIG n left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO n1 on n.SEC_ACCT_ID=n1.SEC_ACCT_ID where n.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY n.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t1 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t1.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( ps, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (ps)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') ps from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t2 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t2.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( TERM_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (TERM_TYPE)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') termType from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t3 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t3.BATCH_SEQ
m.FEE_TYPE=#{feeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and m.TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket}
order by m.BATCH_SEQ,m.EFF_DATE desc

SELECT m.BATCH_SEQ AS batchSeq, m.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, t1.secAcctId, t2.ps AS ps, t3.termType AS termType, m.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, m.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, m.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, m.EFF_DATE as effDate, m.CHARGE_BASIS as chargeBasis, m.FEE_MAXI as feeMaxi, m.FEE_MINI as feeMini, m.CHARGE_VALUE as chargeValue, m.CHARGE_RATE * 1000 as chargeRate, m.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE as isPayWithTrade,m.WINDTYPEONE windtypeone,m.WINDTYPETWO windtypetwo,m.IS_GRADE isGrade,m.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarketMode FROM ( select distinct BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else T1.CHARGE_VALUE end as CHARGE_VALUE, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else T1.FEE_MAXI end as FEE_MAXI, CASE when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else t1.FEE_MINI end as FEE_MINI, case when t.IS_GRADE='Y' then null else t1.CHARGE_RATE end as CHARGE_RATE, t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,t.WINDTYPEONE,t.WINDTYPETWO,t.IS_GRADE,t.TRADE_MARKET_MODE from TRD_FEE_CONFIG t inner join TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL t1 on t.SEQ_NO=t1.CONFIG_SEQ_NO where t.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY t.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET , FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE,CHARGE_BASIS,T1.FEE_MAXI,t1.FEE_MINI,T1.CHARGE_VALUE,t1.CHARGE_RATE,t.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,t.WINDTYPEONE,t.WINDTYPETWO,t.IS_GRADE,t.TRADE_MARKET_MODE ) m INNER JOIN ( select n.BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( n.sec_acct_id, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (n.sec_acct_id)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') secAcctId from TRD_FEE_CONFIG n where n.FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY n.BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t1 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t1.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( ps, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (ps)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') ps from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t2 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t2.BATCH_SEQ INNER JOIN ( select BATCH_SEQ,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( TERM_TYPE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (TERM_TYPE)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') termType from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where FEE_TYPE IN('B02','B05','B01','B07') GROUP BY BATCH_SEQ,TRADE_MARKET ,FEE_TYPE,TRADE_TYPE,CHARGE_TYPE,EFF_DATE ) t3 on m.BATCH_SEQ=t3.BATCH_SEQ where m.BATCH_SEQ = #{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct m.SEC_ACCT_ID AS id, m.SEC_ACCT_NAME AS text FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO m where m.TRADE_PLACE in ('03','04') and ((m.SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))) or (m.SEC_ACCT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))))
SELECT distinct m.REGIST_ORG FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO m where m.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: delete from TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL where CONFIG_SEQ_NO in (select SEQ_NO from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where BATCH_SEQ=#{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT tfcd.SEQ_NO seqNo, tfcd.CHARGE_VALUE chargeValue, tfcd.FEE_MAXI feeMaxi, tfcd.FEE_MINI feeMini, tfcd.CHARGE_RATE chargeRate, tfcd.CONFIG_SEQ_NO configSeqNo, tfcd.GRADE_AMOUNT gradeAmount, tfcd.IS_CLUDE_STARTAMT isCludeStartamt FROM TRD_FEE_CONFIG_DETAIL tfcd join (select * from TRD_FEE_CONFIG where BATCH_SEQ=#{batchSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1) tfc on tfcd.CONFIG_SEQ_NO=tfc.SEQ_NO order by tfcd.GRADE_AMOUNT
